scope: Assumed-MTF observation projection on the frozen diagnostic subset; not calibrated CAS500 physics
input_predictions: Reuse verified CK + experiment-82 calibration predictions from the no-projection diagnostic
subset: Exactly config.json selected_patch_indices, no additional patch selection

gain_basis.kind: simulation assumption, not a measured L2G MTF
gain_basis.additional_assumption: The source study uses RGB airborne imagery; equal NIR gain 0.26 is an additional assumption here

kernel: experiment 54 gen_mtf, radial Kaiser, signed taps and DC gain unchanged
projection: experiment 79 Projector conjugate gradient and autograd adjoint, unchanged
metrics: same common.metrics.fr_metrics as the no-projection diagnostic; Python reference only
observation_metric: interior RMSE of assumed D(prediction) - input MS in DN; consistency only, not reconstruction accuracy
